Clerk

Billing unit: MRU — Monthly Retained User — counted only if the user returns 24+ hours after signup Source: clerk.com/pricing, checked 2026-11-07. Visit Clerk

Answer · Clerk cost by MAU (no SSO)

10k users: $0/mo on Hobby · 50k users: $0/mo on Hobby · 100k users: $1,025/mo on Pro.

  • 1k users · no SSO: Hobby lists $0/mo: tie at $0 with 13 other plans.
  • 10k users · 1 SSO: Pro at $125/mo ranks #14 (tied) of 25, $1,500/yr more than Auth0 Free (assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection: Clerk Pro $125/mo includes $100/mo B2B Authentication add-on).
  • 50k users · 5 SSO: Pro at $425/mo ranks #8 of 18, $4,929/yr more than Firebase Auth / Identity Platform Pay as you go (assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection: Clerk Pro $425/mo includes $100/mo B2B Authentication add-on) (Firebase Auth / Identity Platform’s SSO assumes 200 SSO users per connection).
  • 100k users · 10 SSO: Pro at $1,800/mo ranks #12 of 18, $20,949/yr more than Supabase Auth Pro (platform) (assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection: Clerk Pro $1,800/mo includes $100/mo B2B Authentication add-on) (Supabase Auth’s SSO assumes 200 SSO users per connection).

As of 2026-11-07, from 34 verified plan rows. SSO users: Amazon Cognito, Supabase Auth and Firebase Auth / Identity Platform bill SAML/OIDC per SSO user, not per connection (first 50 free, then $0.015 per SSO user a month). Their SSO results here assume 200 SSO users per connection (5 connections = 1,000 SSO users). See how 1,000 or 2,000 per connection changes the result or set your own. B2B: every SSO result assumes 1 customer organization per SSO connection (members = its SSO users, 200 by default). Published org caps and fees are applied, e.g. Clerk’s $100/mo B2B Authentication add-on above 20 members or 100 orgs, Auth0 Free’s 5-org cap, Descope $1/tenant over 35; plans over a cap are left out.   • Business: 100 MROs and 20 members per org free; above either, B2B Authentication add-on $100/mo ($85 annual) with 100 included, then $1 (101–1,000), $0.90 (1,001–10,000), $0.75 (10,001–100,000), $0.60 (100,001+) per org. source · 2026-10-31

Clerk pricing FAQ

How much does Clerk cost at 10k, 50k and 100k users?

10k users: $0/mo on Hobby; 50k users: $0/mo on Hobby; 100k users: $1,025/mo on Pro. Cheapest verified Clerk plan, monthly USD list price, no SSO, from https://clerk.com/pricing (checked 2026-11-07).

How does Clerk count billable users?

Clerk bills by MRU: Monthly Retained User — counted only if the user returns 24+ hours after signup.

Does Clerk charge for SCIM / Directory Sync?

Hobby: Not offered on this plan. Pro: Separate from SSO: 1 included, then $75 (2–15), $60 (16–100), $48 (101–250) per connection; billed from 2027-01-01. Business: Separate from SSO: 1 included, then $75 (2–15), $60 (16–100), $48 (101–250) per connection; billed from 2027-01-01.
